01 · A story at the centre

A welcoming gesture, framed by a city that never stops moving.

The National Gallery of Indonesia records the bronze Selamat Datang Monument as a 1962 work for welcoming guests to Jakarta’s fourth Asian Games. Henk Ngantung made the sketch/design; Edhi Sunarso and the Pematung Keluarga Arca Yogyakarta team executed the sculpture.

The work is recorded at the Hotel Indonesia roundabout in Central Jakarta, on the Jalan M.H. Thamrin corridor. The location pin is useful for orientation; a street address in a listing is not automatically a visitor entrance.

Pause for a moment. Watch the city orbit a welcome.

What to know

Separate the landmark from permitted walking access.

The monument stands on a traffic island within the roundabout. View only from permitted pedestrian areas or viewpoints. Do not cross vehicle lanes to approach the pool, statue base or roundabout island.

Access

Follow signs, designated crossings and staff directions. A map does not authorize traffic-island access.

Charges

No current tariff or free-access guarantee has been verified. Transport and individual viewpoints have separate conditions.

Hours

Maps checked on 19 October 2026 did not show operating hours. Neither 24-hour nor night access is guaranteed.

Photography

Choose a permitted position without blocking pedestrians. Station decks and business premises have their own entry conditions.

05 · Questions worth asking

Before you arrive.

Adisurahman · CC BY-SA 4.0 · 2009 documentation; not a live view.

Where is Selamat Datang Monument?

The work stands in the Hotel Indonesia roundabout on the Jalan M.H. Thamrin corridor, Central Jakarta. Use the landmark pin for orientation; a listing address is not a visitor entrance.

May I approach the statue base?

Do not assume the traffic island, pool or statue base is open for entry. Use permitted pedestrian routes and follow signs and staff; do not cross vehicle lanes.

Is it open 24 hours and free?

No current operating schedule or free-access guarantee has been verified. Maps checked on 19 October 2026 did not display hours. Viewpoints, stations, events and other services have separate conditions.

What is the local MRT station called?

Official MRT Jakarta material uses Bundaran HI Bank Jakarta. Confirm open entrances/exits, routes and service hours with the operator; no fixed walking time is guaranteed.

Are car-free days and viewing decks always available?

No. Check announcements for your intended date, deck access rules and road arrangements. An earlier event or photograph does not establish present access.
